config.refresh_k: inf (I1 compares warm paths without a revocation re-check, as the BSM warm path has none)
config.condition: M0, mock mobility, real cryptography, no radio channel

I1.claim: median warm SPaT verify / median warm SSI BSM verify in [0.8, 1.2]; falsified if > 2.0

I2.claim: each of the 13 registered checks rejected with its expected reason in every run (amendment A4)

I5.claim: reported, no verdict; a sum of operation costs, not a path latency (amendment A3)
I5.definition: per run, the sum of four per-run medians: controller sign + RSU warm verify + RSU SPaT sign + vehicle warm SPaT verify; across runs, the median of that sum. TMC hop = TMC sign + controller warm verify. No update period, queuing, network or tail is included; in the harness the SPaT does not consume the controller update.
